description_zh: 梅赛德斯-奔驰在并线处停车等待让行，后方马自达低速（<5mph）未能及时停下发生追尾；选后车马自达为ego，测试其对前方静止车辆的制动能力。

source_snippets: The Mercedes-Benz was traveling eastbound on Condensa Street at the merge of the eastbound Central Expressway. The driver of the Mercedes-Benz was yielding to cross-traffic and came to a complete stop as he waited for an opening to merge.

The driver of the Mazda following the Mercedes-Benz did not come to a stop and contacted the Mercedes-Benz at the rear bumper. The Mazda was travel <5mph at the time of contact with the Mercedes-Benz.
evidence.reason: 后方车辆（Mazda）处于移动状态并追尾静止前车，具有测试价值，选为ego；前车静止在同车道前方，用stopped_ahead表达。
